prompts.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: a single transparent furniture sprite for Ojjuda's illustrated apartment. Image 1 is the approved style and object reference. Extract and reconstruct ONLY the warm oak WRITING DESK standing along the RIGHT wall of that room, with all obscured parts completed naturally. Make this the FRONT / CENTER view: camera centered on the long seating side, no horizontal yaw, straight verticals, both front feet on exactly the same horizontal ground line; slight elevated view shows a modest amount of the rectangular tabletop. One desk only, large in a 1536x1024 landscape canvas, comfortable transparent margin around every edge, complete feet, no cropping. The desk has the same warm honey-oak color and soft polished wood grain as the reference, a broad rectangular top with softly eased edges, a narrow apron beneath it, four slim gently tapered square oak legs, a completely open knee space; match the simple visible construction of the reference, without adding cabinet pedestals or ornate details. Proportions: tabletop width 3 units, depth 1 unit, overall height 1.6 units. Keep these dimensions for the later left and right views. Remove every other item: no chair, lamp, books, framed art, pencils, plant, cabinet, people, pet, walls, floor, UI, text or labels. Actual alpha transparency around AND between the legs, not a checkerboard painted in the image. The feet are level and grounded at z=0; no floating leg and no tilted base. Retain soft natural daylight on the desk, cream highlights and gentle self-shading, matching the original illustration's material and painterly 3D finish. No external cast shadow, floor patch, vignette or backdrop. This is the first of three separate view files, not a contact sheet, not a collage.

Use case: background-extraction. Produce a separate LEFT three-quarter view of the EXACT SAME oak writing desk from Image 1. Image 1 defines the finished desk's construction, proportions, wood color and materials. Image 2 is only the original approved home style reference. Rotate the viewpoint to see the long seating FRONT face and the short LEFT end, with a modest view of the top. This must be a newly rendered real viewpoint, not a horizontally flipped picture. Preserve the same broad rectangular tabletop with subtly eased edges, slender apron, four slightly tapered square legs and completely open knee space. Same dimensions: width 3, depth 1, total height 1.6. Soft cream daylight, warm natural honey-oak grain and restrained gentle shadows, matching Image 1. All four legs must reach one level floor plane, straight verticals, no floating feet or tilted frame. Entire single desk centered in a 1536x1024 landscape canvas, ample transparent margins, no cropped legs. True alpha transparency outside the furniture and in the open knee area. Nothing besides the desk: no chair, books, lamp, plant, frame, wall, room, floor patch, cast shadow, labels, text, UI or collage. A single transparent desk asset, not multiple views in one image.

Use case: background-extraction. Produce a separate RIGHT three-quarter view of the EXACT SAME oak writing desk from Image 1. Image 1 defines the completed desk's construction, proportions, honey-oak color, rounded tabletop edge and four slim square tapered legs. Image 2 provides the original approved apartment style. Turn the viewpoint so the long seating FRONT face and the short RIGHT end are visible, with a modest view of the tabletop. The right end is on the right side of the composition. Independently render this viewpoint; do not mirror or flip a previous image. Preserve the same rectangular top, narrow apron and fully open knee space. Dimensions remain width 3, depth 1, overall height 1.6. Every leg lands on the same flat floor plane, upright verticals, consistent perspective, level base. Whole desk centered in a 1536x1024 landscape image, ample empty margins and complete feet. Match soft cream daylight and warm natural oak grain in Image 1, no changes to color or wood species. Real transparent alpha background, including between the legs. No surrounding room, floor patch, external cast shadow, brown backdrop, glow, chair, lamp, books, plant, art frame, text, labels, UI or other objects. This is one furniture cutout and one view, not a sheet of views.
